result.stdout:
InertiaSharp CLI — scaffold ASP.NET Core + Inertia.js starter projects

Usage:
  inertiasharp [project-name]
  inertiasharp --help
  inertiasharp --version

Description:
  Interactive wizard that asks you:
    1. API style   : MVC Controllers or Minimal API
    2. Database    : SQLite, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server
    3. Frontend    : Vue 3 + Reka UI, React + shadcn/ui, or Svelte + 
shadcn-svelte
    4. Auth        : ASP.NET Core Identity (login, register, profile, 
permissions)
                     or a simple home page with a database query

Examples:
  inertiasharp
  inertiasharp MyApp
